## How it was tested

- [ ] Unit tests pass (`xcodebuild test … -only-testing:ForumindTests`, see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)

## Checklist

- [ ] Added, removed, or renamed files or targets? Re-ran `ruby scripts/generate_project.rb` (without a team) and committed the project
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, settings, or DEBUG launch arguments changed
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, Team IDs, personal data, or real forum users in the diff or screenshots
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (use the offline `-dc-sample` data)
